title: ArchMap Next topology requirements baseline
description: Formalize the approved System Topology and Boundary Visualization direction, reconcile it with released ArchMap semantics, and run an FQA ambiguity/loss check before implementation.
completion_criteria: Resource, Container Boundary, Overlay Boundary, Edge, Crossing, Overlay Transition, and View responsibilities are normative.
Crossing and transition derivation is deterministic and independent from layout geometry.
Legacy node/zone/boundary/subgraph/layer/boundaryCrossing behavior has an explicit migration disposition.
FQA findings identify and resolve semantic ambiguity before implementation tasks begin.
success_criteria: An implementer can build analysis fixtures without guessing boundary order or projection behavior.
Existing syntax is not removed in the first Next release.
UI work cannot precede the canonical analysis proof gate.
